rendered:
The question's premise isn't supported by the document. It never reports a limit of detection for S. aureus, so it gives no reason why S. aureus would have the lowest LOD. LODs are given only for P. aeruginosa had an LOD of OD600 =0.0034 (CD,[1] and for L. monocytogenes, which presented an LOD of 0.0123 (CD, Fig. S17c)[2].

The data actually point the other way: S. aureus gave the weakest response. In Fig. 2[3], it produced the CD difference with the smallest magnitude of all the bacteria tested (a vision model's reading of the plot puts it at about -14 mdeg[4]). The text also says only partial discrimination was achieved for S. typhimurium and S. aureus[5].
